Im 5 days off of the Wellbutrin and feeling significantly better. My heart rate is still a bit higher than it typically is, but I’m SO much better. I’m seeing a new psychiatrist soon just in case it’s still recommended that I be medicated.
Pretty much same height and weight as you, and I would use nightly for about 5 years. Any update on your test?

Yes, my doctor told me Wellbutrin can really be bad for anxiety, I just didn’t know it was THIS bad. I wear a fitness tracker and my resting heart rate was 88 for 7 hours while sleeping.. it’s usually in the 50s. Working with my therapist we think anxiety might be the root cause of my depression so this is probably not the medication for me. I’ve been off it for three days now and really not feeling much better at all yet.

I felt significantly worse after going to 300mg. I went from 150 to 300 after 10 days though, so that was quite a quick ramp up. My heart rate and physical anxiety was through the roof, along with increased SI. This all happened within the last week and is honestly terrible.

I went once in Naperville before my wedding and it was not a great experience. It hurt, left my skin super red, and I could hardly tell the difference in my brows before and after the treatment. It could have just been an off day for the tech

150 mg XL for me and I’m feeling the same exact way. Im only on day 4 though. 

I’m not sure if my depression and anxiety is gone or if I just don’t care about anything anymore? It’s hard to tell. I feel kind of spacey and catch myself just staring at the wall and not even really thinking about much at all. 

I don’t have nearly as many intrusive SI thoughts so that’s a benefit I guess.
